title: Flow Duplicate Io Channel Labels
description: Input/output channel names appear twice in the flow editor because port labels are painted both via Vello (paint_port_labels) and the JS Canvas 2D overlay (port_label_overlay_rows). Skip Vello port label painting when delegated to the JS overlay.
summary: Channel names were still doubled because stale `flow_core` WASM kept painting port labels via Vello while the JS overlay also drew them. `wasmPackInputsStale` now checks path-dependency `lib.rs`/`Cargo.toml` files so DAG changes trigger a flow WASM rebuild. `paint_port_labels` early-returns when labels are delegated to the JS overlay. Rebuilt `flow_core_bg.wasm`.
